correction_contract.aggregate_fields: Common estimates and minima are null if any required channel estimate is unavailable. Never average away per-channel rejection or omit an invalid channel from a minimum. Preserve per-channel reasons and validity counts.
correction_contract.candidate_selection: Exclude invalid envelope and sampled correlations before ranking. No valid coarse or sample candidate means unsupported with no invented lag. If there is no valid alternative outside the exclusion interval, ambiguity margin is null and support abstains. Fractional interpolation requires both valid neighbors.
correction_contract.gain_and_polarity: Zero cross product has linear gain zero but no finite dB gain and no defined polarity. No -999 dB sentinel. Correlation validity is separate from gain. No sample correction or inverse gain is applied.
correction_contract.invalid_correlation: An explicit typed result with null value and a reason; never a number in the valid [-1,1] range. Magnitude is null for an invalid result. Valid negative correlations, including exactly -1, retain their sign.
correction_contract.local_windows: Exclude invalid local candidates. Missing windows cannot contribute fallback lags or perfect correlations to drift or structural regression. Require all originally declared windows for each regression; otherwise slope, residual and minimum correlation are null, with explicit support rejection.
correction_contract.numerics: Scale finite vectors before dot products and centered products to avoid avoidable overflow and underflow. This is internal diagnostic arithmetic, not waveform normalization. Preserve overlap, stride, lag ordering and existing support thresholds. A genuinely undefined centered correlation on a constant envelope abstains without an undeclared fallback search.

next_requirement: Use explicit validity in any later score-free integration; do not coerce this successor into the legacy oracle schema. Target-matched normalization, source support and controlled human calibration remain separate prerequisites.
